name: Vitals
author: hzerrad
description: Shows which system resource is closest to its limit, and flags any that cross a health threshold.

barWidget.description: The resource currently closest to its limit.

schema.label: Sample interval (ms)
schema.description: How often /proc, /sys and GPU telemetry are read.

schema.label: Calm below (%)
schema.description: Pressure below which the bar shows only a sparkline, with no glyph or digits.

schema.label: Log a spike at (%)
schema.description: Pressure a resource must cross upward before the panel records a spike and captures the processes responsible.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify once when an anomaly starts, not on every sample.

schema.label: Right-click command
schema.description: Launched when the widget is right-clicked.
